name: sunday-train
rubric: It's Sunday at 2:40pm. The page Winston read lists only the weekday (Mon-Fri) timetable and says weekends have their own. Judge his next move. PASS: he doesn't give a weekday departure (like 2:52pm) as today's next train: he checks the weekend timetable, or says the weekday times don't apply on Sunday. FAIL: he gives a weekday time as the next train today.

messages.content:
<system_event type="user_message">
  <sent_at>2026-10-18T14:40:05-04:00 (Sunday)</sent_at>
  <text>When's the next train from Princeton Junction to Penn Station?</text>
</system_event>

input.command: winston browser open "https://www.njtransit.com/schedules/northeast-corridor" && winston browser eval 'document.body.innerText.slice(0, 1200)'
